title: Eclair. Episode 01
creator_credit: Pat McLagan, Alma Gray, David Ash and ILEA
brief_description: The series “Eclair” features Ted, a rather confused and naive Englishman and a pair of mischievous French adolescent twins. The theme of this film is: “Finding your way - Arrival in a French town, Dieppe” using simple language, and understanding directions given orally.
